Services

Robotics, software and the systems behind them.

We can take on one part of development or connect several disciplines in a single system. We agree the scope, timeline and validation approach before starting.

Robotics

Robotic systems and computer vision

We develop software that helps robots perceive their surroundings, plan movement and carry out tasks. Our work includes object handling, sorting and agricultural applications.

SortingObject handlingField work
How we get started

We begin with the process, equipment and operating conditions. A prototype or simulation helps us check feasibility before further development. We use ROS and ROS 2 to connect robotic components.

Applied AI

Software for documents and data

We build tools for document search, data processing and application integration. We use AI where it can help with a specific part of the job.

DocumentsDataYour apps
Data and operation

We agree which sources the system can access and where data is processed. Answers can link to their sources, while actions that need approval remain under your control. We adapt the solution to local or cloud infrastructure.

Project in development

Language-based instructions for agricultural robots.

As part of the AI-BOOST competition, we are developing an approach that turns everyday instructions into a work plan for an agricultural robot. Our proposal was selected for the ADVANCE phase. Prototype development and validation are ongoing.

About the AI-BOOST competition ↗
Selected for ADVANCEAI-BOOST

Challenge 1: agricultural robotics

  1. 01

    Describe the task

    The user specifies what the robot should do and where.

  2. 02

    Build the plan

    The system creates a plan using actions the robot supports.

  3. 03

    Review and run

    The plan must be checked before execution. The system needs to identify requests it cannot carry out.

Prototype in development

We are developing planning and action validation. Testing on the target robot is still ahead.

Software and integration

Connecting documents and business applications

We develop assistants that retrieve information from selected sources and help with application workflows. The aim is to reduce searching and repetitive steps, with source checking and approval of actions.

Our product

Motiq AI agent

We are preparing our own AI agent for working with documents, information and business applications.

Our aim is to bring information retrieval and repetitive tasks into one tool, with verifiable sources and approval of important actions.

About the name

A good tool makes the job easier.

Motiq takes its name from motika, the Croatian word for a hoe: a simple tool with a clear purpose. We follow the same idea in development: understand the work and build a tool that helps.
